metadata.station_dedup_rule: One latest report per stationNumber, using obsDateTime first and entryDateTime/dateTimeStamp as tie-breakers; falls back to rounded coordinates when stationNumber is missing.

query.api_rows_scope_note: California feed is filtered from the CONUS API rows using stationNumber prefix CA-.

Upper air low pressure that previously had been offshore of San Francisco moved ESE and centered over Central California on Thursday the 19th. Subsequent deep-layer instability pushed a squall line SE over the area with near continuous thunder from interior cloud lightning accompanied by TRW/R+ over the station late morning. A following short-wave trof brought another band or RW/RW+ mid-afternoon. Rainfall from the current event so far totals 1.92".
